function.name: recipe_calculator_calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time to cook a recipe based on weight and per unit time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the item to be cooked. This is a float type value.

per_unit_time.description: The time required to cook per unit weight.

unit_of_time.description: Unit of time, such as minutes or hours. Default is minutes.

message.content:
I’m happy to help you plan your meal!  
Could you let me know:

* Which specific chicken dish you’re interested in (e.g., roasted whole chicken, grilled thighs, fried drumsticks)?
* How many pieces or how much total weight you’ll be preparing?
* Any particular flavor profile or cuisine style you’d prefer?

Once I have those details, I can give you a tailored recipe—including ingredients, steps, seasoning ideas—and even calculate an estimated cooking time using our built‑in calculator.
